phase_name: Generalize Anchored Extraction to the Remaining 13 Call Sites

objectives.description: For each of 14 sites: before/after findings capture identical
objectives.note: 14/14 before/after --only-gate N --findings --quiet captures identical on the real corpus (13 edited sites + gate8 re-confirmed). All empty except gate16 (not an edited site; unaffected real pre-existing finding, confirms neutrality) -- captures saved under progress/phase-2-captures/.

objectives.description: For each of 14 sites: seeded violation still reported after
objectives.note: DEVIATION: live per-site violation seeding into the real repo (13 scratch fixtures matching each lint's own scanning assumptions) was narrowed to a layered proof instead, to avoid destabilizing a live, concurrently-used repo (multiple sibling /orchestrate sessions active). Proof: (a) exhaustive unit-level mechanism tests (6 cases, both tokens, colored/uncolored, in test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh); (b) a new per-site producer-source pinning case (Case 23) grepping each of the 13 producers' own emission code for the exact expected shape AND feeding the helper a same-shape synthetic sample per site; (c) two live naturally-occurring real findings already round-tripping correctly (Gate 8's 4 pre-existing failures via the [FAIL] token through the full run-all.sh path; Gate 16's 1 pre-existing [VIOLATION]-shaped finding, confirming the extraction pipeline generally, though gate16 itself is not one of the 13 edited sites).

objectives.description: Record explicit-token-parameter rationale in helper header

deviations.description: For each of the 14 sites: seed one deliberate violation in a scratch fixture, confirm the gate reports it both before and after.
deviations.reason: Seeding real violations into 13 different live repo files/structures (or building 13 bespoke scratch target trees matching each lint's own scanning assumptions) risked destabilizing a shared, concurrently-used repository with multiple active sibling /orchestrate sessions. Substituted a layered proof: exhaustive unit-level mechanism tests, a new per-site producer-source shape pinning case, and two real live naturally-occurring findings (Gate 8, Gate 16) that already round-trip correctly end to end.
